name: The Unholy Dead
text: You have turned your necromancy against the divine powers that seek to stop you from achieving your unholy goals. You and your thralls gain the unholy trait. Strikes your thralls make gain the unholy trait and deal 1 additional spirit damage. This additional spirit damage increases to 2 at 10th level. You also gain the following anathema: "destroy undead of no harm to you."
